result.reason: The added subsection reaches the preferred position: it applies upon any expiry or termination, requires up to six months of reasonable transition assistance at Garman’s then-current rates, mandates return of Sparkling’s data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and requires subsequent deletion and written certification. The amendment is narrowly confined to the missing exit obligations, preserves the existing termination rights and consequences, and is professionally drafted.
